CHARACTER_LOCKS: 小猫: Cartoon young kitten (child), round baby face, big amber eyes, cream-and-orange tabby fur, short rounded ears, small pink nose; wearing a small round flat-brim straw hat with green chin cord, mint linen han-style short-sleeve tunic with white sash, light blue shorts, brown cloth shoes; soft pastel,; 猫妈妈: Cartoon adult female cat, gentle oval face, warm brown eyes, soft beige fur with slightly darker ears and tail tip; pastel peach long-sleeve han-style robe with white inner layer and pale green sash, light gray cloth shoes; calm smile; soft pastel palette.
PROP_LOCKS: 竹鱼竿: Single-piece green bamboo fishing pole about 1.5 meters with visible nodes, no reel, plain cotton line tied to tip, tiny barbless hook; slim and flexible; held in two paws or planted upright in soil. (forbidden: telescopic carbon rod, spinning reel, metal rod, modern lure, fiberglass rod); 小草帽: Small round flat-brim rice-straw hat, woven spiral texture, short dome crown, green cloth chin cord tied under chin; child size. (forbidden: baseball cap, cone farmer hat, beanie, helmet, hood); 小鱼桶: Small cylindrical wooden pail with vertical staves and dark iron bands, curved iron bail plus brown leather shoulder strap for back-carry; roughly 20 cm tall, about 3-liter capacity. (forbidden: plastic bucket, steel bucket, basket, net bag, backpack); 浮漂: Small red-and-white gourd-shaped cork bobber on the fishing line; thumb-sized, lightweight, sits upright on calm water. (forbidden: LED float, foam stick float, feather, strike indicator, multihook lure); 小银鱼: Tiny silver minnow about 10 cm long, narrow torpedo body, forked tail, shiny scales, black bead eye; palm-size. (forbidden: goldfish, koi, carp, big trout, crab); 蝴蝶: Colorful swallowtail-like butterfly with gradient cyan–magenta–yellow wings edged with black veins, thin curved antennae; wingspan about 5–6 cm; delicate, lively flight. (forbidden: moth, bird, dragonfly, bee, ladybug)

eventChain: S1: Kitten arrives at the willow-lined lakeside wearing a straw hat, carrying wooden bucket and bamboo rod; Mother advises to focus.
S2: The hook is gently cast; the red-white bobber trembles as the kitten watches the water intently.
S3: A colorful butterfly hovers around the kitten and flits toward the wildflowers; the rod remains in the water as the kitten gets distracted.
S4: Decision point — chase the butterfly or keep watching the bobber.
S5: Outcome 1 — the kitten chases the butterfly into the wildflower patch, then returns tired; the bobber is still, the rod stands alone by the shore.
S6: Ending 1 — the kitten walks home empty-handed; confesses distraction; Mother comforts and reminds to stay focused.
S7: Outcome 2 — the kitten resists distraction, waits patiently; the bobber suddenly sinks; the kitten lifts the rod and lands a small silver fish.
S8: Ending 2 — the fish is placed into the bucket; on the village path home the kitten and Mother smile, praising patience and focus.
